{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check how many rows are dropped when computing correlation
# We'll use the same column pair and let pandas handle missing values

# Compute correlation with default (pairwise complete)
corr = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].corr().iloc[0, 1]

# Also check the number of non-null pairs
n_pairs = df[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].dropna().shape[0]

print(f'Correlation: {corr}')
print(f'Number of complete pairs: {n_pairs}')"}
